positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Architected a CI/CD pipeline to collect performance metrics of numerous software development teams, leveraging automated data collection via Talend tool suite, persisting data using Postgresql, and visualizing data using Tableau.
•	Developed initial prototype cloud software services and refactored legacy software services in order for services to be hosted in a Kubernetes cloud environment.
•	Developed Flight Operational software for Vehicle Management Computer on various unmanned air vehicle programs using Green Hills Integrity and WindRiver VxWorks RTOS environments.  Developed Air Vehicle Management software for handling propulsion system management, power system management, and various simulation systems.
•	Collaborated with supplier engineering teams in order to develop software design requirements and troubleshoot software for various subsystems, including Air Vehicle propulsion, Cockpit Displays, and I/O units.
•	Provided onsite engineering support for hardware integration while following processes for a manufacturing facility at remote test facility in order to support flight test schedule and timely air vehicle delivery. 
•	Developed and reviewed LabVIEW test applications for hardware Acceptance Test procedures.  Delivered application that tests air vehicle flight actuator and actuator controller electronics within deadline.
•	Developed Test Automation tools using Python scripting language in order to transition legacy manual tests into automated tests and enable CI/CD potential.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Systems · C++ · Java · NI LabVIEW

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed Takeoff & Landing Performance calculations and air vehicle health & fault detection functionalities for C-130 and C-17 air vehicle Mission Computer flight software using Ada programming language in order to ensure pilot and air vehicle safety.
•	Developed test scripts using Automatic Test Controller language in order to test new Required Navigation Performance functionality of the C-17 Mission Processor software was in accordance with requirements, allowing timely completion of quality tests and delivery of flight test software builds.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked with e-Commerce back-end services built upon Java design patterns.
